```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fixest)
library(patchwork)
library(stargazer)
library(nlme)
library(plm)
```



```{r reading}

pitching <- read.csv("pitching_2015_2024.csv")


#selecting only pitchers with more than 100 IP because they are most likely starters and will have the most consistent data
pitching_selected <- pitching[ pitching$IP > 100, c("WHIP", "ERA", "HR.9", "Age", "K.9", "Team", "Season")]



```


```{r}
#Model 1 with only WHIP, the most influential variable based on prior experience

model1 <- lm(ERA ~ WHIP, data = pitching_selected)
summary(model1)
```
